rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the act or occurrence of duplication.

example.english: There is some duplication in this document, so we need to delete a section.
example.traditional: 呢份文件有啲重複，要刪走一段。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 jau5 di1 cung4 fuk1 jiu3 saan1 zau2 jat1 dyun6

rows.note: Use this when “duplication” means an extra copy or duplicate document.

example.english: I need a duplication of this document for the meeting.
example.traditional: 我想要呢份文件嘅副本，開會用。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 ge3 fu3 bun2 hoi1 wui2 jung6
